script.problem: The one line is more than one sentence.

terra.problem: The Bible does not identify Hamath-zobah as a region, while Schaff describes it as a city. Its precise nature is uncertain.

The moment includes building at Tadmor and in Hamath, but the passage does not say those places were in Hamath-zobah. It also does not clearly establish that Solomon built the store cities after capturing Hamath-zobah.
